architecture_scope: Full SMP0.4 Segformer mit_b0+256-channel MLP decoder versus original custom ResNet34 U-Net; not an encoder-only ablation or exact NVlabs recipe reproduction
primary_comparison: Same fixed final epoch15, seed42, kidney190 images, 1425 effective updates; selected checkpoints separately diagnostic; no resolution or loss tuning
initialization: Each arm ImageNet encoder plus random decoder, no surgical checkpoint warmstart; pretrained encoder recipes differ and are not controlled
budget_scope: Equal optimizer updates and image exposures, not equal FLOPs or hardware time; record wall time, parameter count, peak CUDA allocation and batch1 inference latency

performance.input: cached native BGR to probabilities/masks; OpenCV preprocessing; excludes decode, display, geometry and temporal memory

constraints: kidney190 supervised only; stone_new banned; reserve800 not read in this training; both videos validation only; provisional training labels and unverified case provenance retained
stop_policy: Existing frozen two-consecutive-epoch foreground-collapse rules; no automatic extension; aborted arms cannot be claimed equal-budget
